explanation: Exchanging business cards is polite and expected in UAE business settings, usually done at the start of a meeting. The approach is relaxed due to the country's international business culture, but you should always offer and receive cards with your right hand, as using the left is considered impolite.
local_tip: Carry two-sided cards with Arabic on one side and English on the other, and present them with your right hand at the beginning of the meeting.

also_check.note: Highly formal two-handed exchange with a bow and careful reading of the card.
Offer and receive with both hands; study the card before putting it away.
Casual exchange, often without ceremony; no strict hand protocol.
